title: IT - Finance - Security Handbook Handoff
summary: Internal handoff to socialize the updated IT/Finance/Security operations handbook for oncall, billing tags, KMS rotation and audit artifact responsibilities ahead of the Q3 SOC2 readiness check. Ownerships for documentation updates and a short pilot of billing export were assigned.
topics: billing tags and cost allocation exports
oncall triage flow and escalation matrix
transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-07-28
Start: 14:30 UTC
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Rachel, Arjun, Priya, Liam, Jamal, Elena, Tom, Marta, Sanjay

[00:00] Rachel: alright folks, thanks for joining on short notice, the goal today is to get the updated ops handbook into the right hands and lock owners for the KMS rotation and the cost tagging pilot. uh, we'll go through sections and call out owners.

[00:22] Jamal: quick question, is this the same doc we saw last week? I thought there was a v2 draft in confluence but i might be looking at an old one.

[00:31] Priya: yeah there's a v2 in confluence, link in the invite but the master copy is in the internal repo — i put a pointer: https://redwood-internal/docs/it-handbook-v2 (note: link may be internal).

[00:46] Elena: perfect, i scanned the security chapter, looks mostly good but i want explicit language around KMS rotate windows and key cust—custody. we need to clarify who initiates rotation and who approves, otherwise audit will flag it.

[01:05] Arjun: we added a rotation cadence of 90 days in the draft, but ops was leaning toward 180 given the integration work for private deployments. so there is a tradeoff.

[01:22] Liam: fwiw, from SRE we prefer 90 for host keys, but for customer-managed keys maybe 180, because handing over rotation during oncall is, uh, messy.

[01:40] Tom: legal note — if a customer is using their own HSM we need to track the evidence separately, but that's covered in the customer data handling appendix. i'll add a cross-ref.

[01:58] Jamal: on the finance side, biggest ask is consistent billing tags. we still have three different conventions across teams, so the first action is a pilot for dedicated capacity cost exports to our cost center.

[02:18] Rachel: yes so proposal: finance pilot with the redwood-dedicated namespace for two teams next month, we instrument the tag schema and export to bigquery, then recon with finance weekly for four weeks.

[02:34] Sanjay: procurement will help ensure any vendor invoices match the same tags. also reminder about reserved capacity contract codes — those need to be on the invoice mapping.

[02:52] Elena: audit logs — current retention is 90 days in the console; security wants 365 for a subset of high‑risk routes. can that be configured per-route?

[03:10] Arjun: technically yes, we have per-route retention in the observability backend, but it's not surfaced in the public console UI. it'll require a small feature flag and a config change in the internal runbook.

[03:28] Priya: i'll own the runbook change, i can open a PR to the infra repo and include the config snippet.

[03:42] Jamal: does longer retention mean big $$ for storage? we need an estimate.

[03:50] Liam: rough back of napkin — 4x for logs if we go from 90 to 365 for those routes, but only for the subset. arjun, can you produce a quick estimate by next tuesday?

[04:05] Arjun: yes, i'll run a query against the ELK buckets and send a sizing + cost delta.

[04:20] Marta: hr/payroll note — any changes that affect PII handling, even internal names, need to go through a quick HR signoff. the handbook had examples with employee email addresses; we should sanitize those.

[04:36] Tom: good call, i'll redline the examples, remove personal data.

[04:50] Rachel: moving to SSO and RBAC: elena flagged some gaps with cross-org roles, particularly around the console's admin role being too broad.

[04:59] Elena: yep chestnut: we have developers seeing dev-costs they shouldn't. proposed change: introduce a billing_viewer role that can only read cost dashboards and not spin up Dedicated.

[05:14] Priya: that's feasible, but we need to update the SCIM mappings in Okta and the role doc. i can draft mappings.

[05:29] Sanjay: procurement needs a list of roles for procurement-approvers to ensure PO creation is gated.

[05:40] Jamal: also can we get a monthly export of cost by tag into finance's bigquery? automated CSV is fine.

[05:51] Arjun: yep we'll add an export job — i'll put a cron in the infra repo. question on cadence: daily or monthly snapshot?

[06:01] Jamal: daily overnight export would be ideal for chargeback, but monthly is okay for initial pilot. let's start monthly then iterate.

[06:15] Rachel: next area: oncall triage — the handbook updates the escalation matrix to include a second-level SRE and a platform SE window. any objections?

[06:28] Liam: works for me, but we need clearer runbooks for KV cache warmups and prefix caching — those are the highest noise sources in mornings.

[06:42] Arjun: i'll link the caching runbook in the handbook, but fair warning the transcriptions on the runbook are rough — i've got a cleanup TODO.

[06:54] Elena: for SOC2 readiness, upcoming audit window is mid-September, so artifacts must be packaged by end of August. who owns artifact packaging?

[07:06] Rachel: proposal: security owns the artifacts, platform provides the exports, finance signs off on billing evidence. we need an artifact inventory doc.

[07:18] Elena: i'll own the inventory — i'll produce a spreadsheet with expected artifact names and owners by Friday (2026-07-31).

[07:30] Jamal: finance will validate billing evidence, i'll assign someone to reconcile invoices and exports with the test dataset.

[07:40] Marta: HR will need to provide org charts and role definitions for the auditor; i'll compile those.

[07:50] Tom: legal will prepare any declarations for third‑party services. also, i want to ensure we have a signed DPA template ready for customers in case of request.

[08:01] Sanjay: procurement will provide vendor contacts and master contract IDs for the auditor.

[08:12] Rachel: okay let's call out explicit action items and deadlines. also a couple of smaller items: documentation hosting (move from confluence to gitbook?) and the handbook distribution list.

[08:25] Priya: i recommend keeping master in repo and a rendered gitbook for consumption — that way PRs are source-controlled.

[08:36] Liam: +1 for PR flow. we should lock editing rights and require a security review tag on PRs touching the security chapter.

[08:48] Rachel: noted. any open objections or questions?

[08:54] Jamal: one more — cost alerts: can we have a daily email digest for teams overspending? tiny threshold or spike detection?

[09:02] Arjun: we can do both: threshold (percent over run rate) and anomaly detection on daily ingestion. I'll prototype alerts tied to slack / email.

[09:14] Elena: don't forget to include alert suppression windows for scheduled load like benchmarks.

[09:22] Arjun: will add suppression config to the alerting runbook.

[09:30] Rachel: ok, let's recap and assign owners.

[09:35] (recap begins)
[09:36] Rachel: owner list: Priya for runbook config changes (audit log retention per-route) due 2026-08-04.

[09:46] Rachel: Arjun to provide log retention sizing + cost delta by 2026-08-03.

[09:55] Rachel: Elena to own artifact inventory for SOC2, deliver spreadsheet by 2026-07-31.

[10:03] Rachel: Jamal to lead billing tags pilot and confirm export cadence, initial weekly recon starting 2026-08-10.

[10:12] Rachel: Tom to sanitize PII examples in the handbook and sign off on legal wording by 2026-08-02.

[10:20] Rachel: Marta to provide HR org charts by 2026-08-07.

[10:28] Rachel: Arjun to prototype cost alerts and suppression rules and demo to finance on 2026-08-05.

[10:36] Rachel: final note: handbook master will be in internal git repo; public render in gitbook will be handled after v2 approvals.

[10:45] (meeting close)

[10:50] Elena: thanks everyone.

[10:52] Jamal: thanks, bye.

Transcription notes: conversational, occasional crosstalk. Some proper nouns may be mistranscribed (KV cache noted as "KV cash" in one run).
action_items: Priya Rao: Update runbook to support per-route audit log retention; create PR (due 2026-08-04)
Arjun Mehta: Produce ELK sizing and cost delta for 90->365 day retention (due 2026-08-03)
Elena Gomez: Create SOC2 artifact inventory spreadsheet and assign owners (due 2026-07-31)
Jamal Turner: Kick off billing tags pilot and schedule weekly recon (start 2026-08-10)
Tom Baker: Remove PII examples and finalize legal text for handbook (due 2026-08-02)
Marta Silva: Provide org charts and role definitions for auditors (due 2026-08-07)
Arjun Mehta: Prototype cost alerting + suppression rules and demo to finance (due 2026-08-05)
next_steps: Standup PR workflow for handbook in internal git repo and render to gitbook
Start billing tag pilot with two teams using 'redwood-dedicated' namespace
Schedule follow-up check-in for 2026-08-06 to review progress on action items
Security to package initial SOC2 artifact bundle by 2026-08-14
